nodes.content: Original Hessian/eta standing conditions; fixed deterministic y,xRef,z0.
Actual continuous harmonic flow, residual rate and integrated hazard; Phi0 identity, Lambda0 zero.
First actual Exp threshold and integrated-hazard first-wait definition; positive actual thresholds AE; empty hit has wait infinity.
Before first event the live initial record gives Phi_t(z0), including infinite wait. Half-open endpoint convention requires <= for possible first-event defect.

Borel total actual phase representative and fixed-parameter actual initialization/coverage; nonexplosion supports inherited alltime realization, not a premise needed merely to identify the first clock.
Measurable actual-phase/harmonic inequality event and norm-tail events.
First-clock survival exp(-Lambda_t) from Exp threshold, independent of a Markov or restart theorem.
Actual/harmonic defect contained in event firstwait<=t, probability bounded by1-exp(-Lambda_t).
Lambda_t tends to0, hence Ex22 first-event probability tends to0.
Phi_t(z0) tends toz0 for relative nonnegative time approaching0.

For each delta>0 the norm-tail is eventually contained in the defect event; fixed-parameter stochastic continuity at0 follows from vanishing probability. This norm-tail formulation is a source-faithful intermediate adapter, not the source full L2 assertion.

necessary_directions: before-event equality + first survival -> defect probability bound
defect bound + Lambda_t->0 -> vanishing defect probability
vanishing defect probability AND Phi_t(z0)->z0 AND delta>0 -> stochastic continuity at0
